description: This file defines the 'Interview' doctype for an HR module, including validation, scheduling, notifications, and related utility functions for managing interview processes.

classes.name: DuplicateInterviewRoundError
classes.description: Custom validation error for duplicate interview rounds.

classes.name: Interview
classes.description: Main doctype class for managing interview records, including validation, scheduling, and notifications.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the interview record for duplicates, designation, and overlaps.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles logic when an interview is submitted, restricting status.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_interview
methods.description: Checks if the same applicant has an existing interview in the same round.

methods.name: validate_designation
methods.description: Ensures the interview's designation matches the applicant's applied role.

methods.name: validate_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping interviews scheduled at the same time.

methods.name: reschedule_interview
methods.description: Reschedules an interview and notifies participants.

methods.name: get_recipients
methods.description: Retrieves email recipients for interview notifications.
